selection_rationale: cnsmauto-3d2k (Compact Action-Aware Staging Benchmark) best matches the programme priority to close the evaluation gap: it targets end-to-end, action-aware safety (staged rollouts, canaries, rollback, auditability), has the strongest venue relevance and novelty among candidates, and is feasible within available resources once the specified design repairs are made. Other candidates (cnsmauto-1a4f, cnsmauto-2b7q, cnsmauto-4e9z) were viable but carry higher immediate risks (verifier-specification and human-review modeling for 1a4f; iteration/looping and verifier-completeness for 2b7q; ethical/dual-use and threat-model specification for 4e9z) that make them less suitable as the single autonomous run target without additional preparatory work.
unresolved_uncertainties: Simulator fidelity vs production control-plane dynamics (how well simulated staged rollouts reflect real network side-effects)
Required benchmark size/diversity to support generalizable claims (is 200 tasks sufficient)
Appropriate canonicalization of staged-rollout semantics across diverse NetOps use cases (canary sizing, monitoring windows, rollback triggers)
Auditability metric definitions and measurability across heterogeneous change types
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Precisely define staged-rollout primitives (canary percentage, monitoring windows, rollback thresholds) and make them tunable parameters to be reported in the preregistration.
Increase task diversity or provide statistical justification for the chosen 200-task corpus; publish the task-selection script, seeds, and controlled splits.
Provide the simulator implementation (repo and commit), representative topologies, and validation demonstrating simulator behaviour matches expected control-plane outcomes for canonical cases.
Formally define the auditability/provenance metric (what constitutes complete provenance) and specify how it will be measured and logged in experiment artifacts.

Prespecify primary and secondary metrics, permutation/robustness tests, and ablation procedures (canary sizes, rollback thresholds) in the preregistration; include planned statistical tests and multiple-comparison corrections.
